title: Worship Piano Fundamentals
description: Build your foundation: notes, steps, scales, finger placement, and the number system — from Worship Piano Academy.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — Notes
lessons.description: Learn the notes on the piano keyboard — the absolute starting point for every worship pianist.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — Steps
lessons.description: Understand whole steps and half steps — the building blocks of all scales and chords.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — Scales
lessons.description: Master major scales and understand how they form the foundation of worship piano playing.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Finger Placement
lessons.description: Learn proper finger placement and technique to play smoothly across the keyboard.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — Number System
lessons.description: Unlock the Nashville Number System — the universal language for playing worship songs in any key.

lessons.title: What is the Nashville Number System? — Deep Dive
lessons.description: Carson Bruce breaks down the Nashville Number System from the ground up — where it came from, how it works, and how to apply it confidently in any worship setting.

lessons.title: Classical vs. Contemporary Worship Piano — The Mindset Shift
lessons.description: A candid conversation about the biggest mental switch a classically trained pianist must make to thrive in a worship band — moving from rigid sheet music to chord charts, creative flexibility, and playing with a band.

lessons.title: Can a Classical Pianist Thrive in Modern Worship?
lessons.description: Sunday Sounds explores whether a classical piano background helps or hinders modern worship playing — and how to bridge the gap.

title: Chords, Inversions & Songs
description: Build chords, play your first worship song, and master inversions, sus chords, and slash chords.

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — Chords
lessons.description: Learn how to build chords from scales — the essential skill for playing worship piano.

lessons.title: Lesson 7 — Playing a Song
lessons.description: Put it all together — play your first complete worship song using the chords you have learned.

lessons.title: Lesson 8 — Inversions
lessons.description: Master chord inversions for smooth transitions between chords — essential for flowing worship playing.

lessons.title: Lesson 9 — Sus Chords
lessons.description: Learn suspended chords and how they create the distinctive sound of modern worship piano.

lessons.title: Lesson 10 — Slash Chords
lessons.description: Master slash chords — playing different bass notes under chords for richer, more professional sound.

lessons.title: Play in ALL 12 Keys in 3 Easy Steps
lessons.description: A simple 3-step method to transpose any worship song into all 12 keys — great for beginners who want to play with any band or singer.

title: Chord Progressions
